Tala pitha

By Ahimanikya Satapathy

Food · Across Odisha

Follow the pulp into two distinct preparations.

Confirm local access, transport and availability before travel.

Research checked 2026-11-06 · Editorial preview

Odisha Food Delite heats water-extracted palm pulp, then stirs in rice powder, coconut, ghee and salt to form dough. It bakes, cools and slices the tala poda pitha. Fruit ripeness is unstated.

Oriyarasoi starts with ripe fruit: squeezing and straining the flesh, then heating and cooling the extract. Rice powder and semolina make a dropping batter, fried in portions. This account describes tala pitha as fritters.
